landed_against.rule: R-17/R-32/D-97 — no baseline moves inside this commit

qualifying_population.rule: 3.2's last amp slice moves Shadowflame's Cinderbloom from `item_effects.MagicTrueCritEffect` — a compiled record carrying `crit_multiplier` and `health_threshold` — onto a declared `delta_amp` rule in the CINDERBLOOM chain slot, whose magnitude is `crit_multiplier - 1` over a live ValueRef and whose activation is `LivePredicate(TARGET_HEALTH_FRACTION, LT, <ref health_threshold>)`. Both numbers are read from the same ITEM_EFFECTS['Shadowflame'] entry the record was compiled from, by the same float arithmetic, and the mechanic's gate is unchanged (the build holds the item). A leaf may therefore move only where it is (a) a leaf of a snapshot entry whose build holds Shadowflame, or (b) an aggregate over (a). No other entry can move: no leaf outside a Shadowflame build reads the record at all. Enumerated from the committed scripts/golden_baseline.json and scripts/golden_coupled_baseline.json, before this slice's first src/ edit.

excluded_by_construction.golden.champion_baselines/**: itemless stat baselines — the section holds no build and the string 'Shadowflame' does not occur anywhere in it. Structurally empty, not assumed empty. 28421 leaves.
excluded_by_construction.golden.registered_champion_fights/<champ: 69 of the 173 registered champions' fight entries hold no Shadowflame build; the record they never compile cannot move a leaf.
excluded_by_construction.golden.item_sweep/<item> other than Shad: one sweep entry per item, each a build holding that item alone.
excluded_by_construction.coupled_scenarios/{catalyst_roster,cleav: no participant's items[] names Shadowflame, read off the committed baseline's own participants[].items rather than typed.

coupled_golden.holder_derivation: combat.participants[0].items[1] == 'Shadowflame' in each of the six scenarios, read off the committed baseline.

measured.note: Measured after the edit against both committed baselines. The pair-golden compare is identical to scripts/golden_baseline.json — zero differing leaves. The coupled compare still reports the campaign's standing difference set, which this slice did not add to and did not shrink: its size is the same before and after the edit, and every member is claimed by an earlier committed expected-diff receipt (tests/test_coupled_golden_allowlist.py). Zero leaves are attributable to this slice in either jurisdiction, so nothing qualifies under R-15 and no oracle receipt is owed. The declared count and the measured count agree, which is what R-20 asks the declaration to do.
